# SEO Validation

Use after route, content, product schema or domain changes.

## Procedure

1. Crawl representative homepage, category, search, PDP, cart and error routes.
2. Check unique title, description, H1, canonical and indexability behavior.
3. Validate product, offer, breadcrumb and organization JSON-LD.
4. Verify internal links, 301 redirects, `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt`.
5. Check Bulgarian content, URL encoding, pagination and duplicate parameter URLs.
6. Report exact URL, observed output, expected output and severity.

Do not make search pages indexable accidentally, and do not claim valid schema without parsing it.
